master:
Use case: sketch-to-render. IMAGE1 determines all geometry; IMAGE2 determines art STYLE only. Render Level08, hand-painted ancient forest platformer, 2048x768, 8:3 canvas. Match the green fixed terrain and beige horizontal FIXED slabs of image1: trace every step, edge, platform length and elevation. Keep upper padding as sky/canopy, terrain bottom-aligned. Do not shift layout or invent routes.
There are three disconnected terrain groups: starting low left bank rising to a high narrow ledge with broad cap, then one lower step on its right; low middle island rising to a higher narrow pier on its right with broad cap; tall right exit bank with lower inward step on left and one lower outward step at far right. Between each group is a deep OPEN pit all the way to bottom. Keep five beige fixed surfaces: cap on left bank, short floating mid-left slab, highest floating mid slab, cap on the middle island's right pier, and inward-protruding short slab on the high exit bank. No bottom floor. A modest empty stone exit arch at yellow marker, no seal/door.
Remove ALL dashed purple/cyan lift/box zones and all guide ropes, poles, pulleys and base plates. The tall rod above middle-right pier must be absent; leave its top clear. Areas below the two floating slabs remain completely open for later elevators. Do not add supporting columns there; tiny angled underside braces only.
Distinct atmosphere: soaring ancient woodland sanctuary, very tall distant ruined colonnades amid huge straight cedar trees, a sunlit forest canyon, pale turquoise depth. A narrow dry vertical rock channel should be visible in the distant background behind the SECOND gap (around 68% of image width), beginning about 40% image height and extending to 90%; no water painted in it, animated water comes later. Mossy cut-stone ruins and natural cliffs, narrow golden-green grassy top silhouettes, detailed vegetation kept low, soft cinematic sunlight. Upper corner foliage only. Premium detailed painted 2D matching image2, not 3D/isometric/pixel. No painted mist sprites, water, particles, or large moving strands. No UI/grid/text/arrows/numbers/characters/spikes/blocks/plates/levers/elevators/reflectors/gems/magic.
